# PR-head worktree: acme/widget#82

## Discovery and success legend

**Aliases.** `R=/work/widget`, `W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` (name `fix-retry`).
SHAs: `A=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`, `B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`, `C=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`, `D=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.

Resolved PR values send the run to `reference/pr-head.md`, which replaces generic Steps 0 and 1.

**Discovery (cwd = session dir)**

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| d1 | `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` | `R/.git`, so ROOT=`R` |
| d2 | `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | empty, so not a submodule |
| d3 | overrides ladder: `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `R/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `R/doc/gauntlet-overrides.md` | none found; no native tool or wrapper; home = `W` |
| d4 | `git -C R fetch origin` | ok |

**Ordered stops (S)**

| Stop | Check |
|---|---|
| S1 | `isCrossRepository` is false |
| S2 | `git -C R worktree list --porcelain` does not list `fix/retry` at another path |
| S3 | `git -C R rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` succeeds, and `git -C R rev-parse origin/fix/retry` = A |
| S4 | `git -C R rev-parse --verify -q refs/heads/fix/retry` finds no local branch, so the ancestry check is skipped |

The pre-write boundary is everything through S4. Only the fetch has touched refs at that point.

**Fresh creation (F)**

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | `git -C R status --porcelain` | empty, clean |
| F2 | `git -C R check-ignore -q .worktrees` | exit 0, already ignored |
| F3 | `git -C R worktree add "W" fix/retry` | Git's unique-remote DWIM performs `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry` internally; the caller never passes `-b` |
| F4 | `git -C R worktree list --porcelain` | contains `worktree W` |
| F5 | `git -C R symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` | empty, so the provenance note is skipped |

**Verify and capture (V)**

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| V1 | `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | A, matches headRefOid |
| V2 | capture | `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A` |
| V3 | `git -C R rev-parse origin/main` | `BASE_SHA=B` |
| V4 | `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` | base is already an ancestor; no commit |

**Report (Rep)**
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
Ready to implement rework of acme/widget#82
```
Record: `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main`.

## Provisioning rows

| Row | Delta from legend |
|---|---|
| **linked** | d1 runs from `R/.worktrees/other` and still yields ROOT=`R`. The tree `other` is not the selected home on `fix/retry`, so it is not adopted and nothing nests inside it. Every command targets `-C R` or `-C W`, and the cwd is never changed. Then S, F, V and Rep run as in the legend. |
| **primary** | Identical to linked, with d1 run from `R`. |
| **ancestor** | S4 finds the branch at C, and `git -C R merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. F3 is replaced by `git -C R update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry` followed by `git -C R worktree add "W" fix/retry` (an existing branch, no DWIM). `branch -f` is never used. Then V and Rep. |
| **reuse** | S2 lists `W` on `fix/retry`, which is the selected home, so this is not a stop. S4 ancestry exits 0. F is skipped. Instead run `git -C W status --porcelain` (clean, so no ask), then `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry`, which takes ccccccc to aaaaaaa. Then V and Rep. |
| **fork** | Stops at S1 with `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` Only d1–d4 ran; nothing was written. |
| **elsewhere** | Stops at S2 with `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` No status check, no add. |
| **unreachable** | The verify in S3 fails. Stop with `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` Nothing was written. |
| **moved** | The verify in S3 succeeds, but `rev-parse origin/fix/retry` returns ddddddd ≠ A. Stop with the same text as unreachable: `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` |
| **ahead** | S4 finds the branch at C, and ancestry exits 1. Stop with `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` No update-ref, no add. |
| **diverged** | Same as ahead: same stop text and same boundary. |
| **override** | d3 finds the overrides file, and `## using-git-worktrees` has `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`. The home is the default `W`. The template contains `-b`, so it is not run, and F3 uses the built-in add. Then V. Rep gains `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. |
| **race** | F3 succeeds, but V1 returns D. Stop with `head race: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry is at ddddddd, expected aaaaaaa; tree left intact.` `W` stays in place. There is no capture, no merge and no report. |

## History

- **Advance by merge.** Every commit reachable from `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A` is preserved.
- **Forbidden at or below A:** no `rebase`, no `reset`, and no `commit --amend` that replaces such a commit. Keeping the tree current means `git -C W merge origin/main`, never a rebase.
- **Allowed exceptions:**
  - The flow's appended-spec `commit --amend --no-edit` (from `spec-finalization.md`).
  - The appended-wave fold `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`, provided `WAVE_BASE_SHA` descends from A. Check this with `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`, which must exit 0.
